What is Hookah?

The hookah, renowned as a tobacco pipe, employs a lengthy flexible tube, channeling smoke through water enclosed within a bowl. This versatile apparatus, available as single-stem or multi-stem, facilitates cannabis heating or vaporization, subsequently enabling inhalation via the connected mouthpiece. Historical accounts indicate the introduction of hookahs to Western civilization during the late 1600s to early 1700s, credited to immigrants from Persia and North Africa. This cultural exchange enhanced the tapestry of smoking traditions across different regions, embedding the hookah as an emblem of social interaction and leisurely enjoyment.

What is Neo Hookah?

Neo Hookah is the modern-day version of smoking hookah, as it combines the Old World tradition with modern aesthetics. The improved design and aesthetics makes the experience even more enjoyable than the old versions allowed. Each Neo Hookah rig is constructed using stainless steel. The stainless steel adds durability, artistry, and easy maintenance, as it is quite easy to polish and maintain it. It comes in a cubic design that is equally functional and artistic.
